main.description: What a person, or a group, has put forward, as far as the caller may read it: motions, amendments, candidacies and questions they own or are named as an author of, and for a person their comments. Drafts included, since they are theirs too. Give `did` or `context`.

context.description: A group or an event, for what it is named as the author of.

profiles.description: A map from DID to profile, for every `by_did` in `items`.
